Short Term Rental - Luxury Executive Home for Lease with Expansive Bay Views - Large 4 bedroom 2.5 bathroom home situated in the heart of North Beach. 
Just steps away from Washington Park and iconic Coit Tower. 
Exclusive back roof space with expansive views of the Bay including Alcatraz and Golden Gate Bridge and Lombard St.
Huge floor to ceiling windows and atrium skylights provides lots of natural light to the upper floor living area and kitchen. 
Spectacular hardwood floors throughout the home. 
Modern and updated furnishings. 
Laundry room and pantry off kitchen.
2 car tandem parking garage included. 
Surrounded by several Bay Area hot spots and destinations

(RLNE6107618)
